messages:
elaine: Heads-up — we saw a regression in the quantized kernel selection path after the batching change landed yesterday. p99 token latency up ~18% for mid-length (200-600) sequences on H100 pool when using int4+fp8 hybrid fallback. Logs and quick repro below.

sam: Ugh. Do you have a quick perf snippet or kernel pick log?

elaine: Pasted the kernel decision trace from a failing run:

```
[selector] seq=384 batch_size=12 avg_seq=210 kvcache_util=0.72 arch=sm90
picked_kernel: fp8_gemm_sharded_v2 (est_tokens/s=120k)
fallback_considered: int4_split_kv (est_tokens/s=155k) reason: mem_budget_violation
notes: mem_estimator inflated by kvcache_pressure_factor=1.3
```

The selector is rejecting the int4 path because the memory estimator applies a pressure multiplier tied to the global kvcache pressure metric. But our workload has high per-request prefix reuse (so actual KV bytes are lower), so the estimator is pessimistic.

raj: That pressure multiplier came from the batching heuristic change — we switched percentile from p90->p95 to reduce small-batch noise (commit 1f7a9b). It made buckets wider, which increased the observed kvcache occupancy statistic we feed into the estimator.

sam: Concrete repro command? I can run locally on a canary.

elaine: Repro:
```
./tools/run_infer --model zh-hybrid_int4_fp8 --gpu sm90 --seq=384 --batch=12 --seed=42 --enable-profiling
# then inspect logs: /tmp/prof/*.kernel_choice.log
```

raj: Thanks. Quick idea: have the kernel picker consult a per-request kvcache_delta (actual KV bytes read) instead of global occupancy for the final mem check. If delta < threshold prefer int4.

sam: Agreed. Also we should expose per-arch tuning knobs rather than a single multiplier. For example: `kv_pressure_multiplier_sm89`, `kv_pressure_multiplier_sm90`, `kv_pressure_multiplier_sm92` with defaults 1.1/1.3/1.15. That should avoid the sm90 over-pessimism.

elaine: Prototype patch attached in the thread (local diff):
```
- mem_estimate *= kv_pressure_multiplier
+ mem_estimate *= max(kv_pressure_multiplier_global, kv_pressure_multiplier_by_arch[arch])
+ // prefer request-level KV delta if available
+ if (request.kv_delta_bytes && request.kv_delta_bytes < kv_delta_hysteresis) {
+   mem_estimate *= 0.85
+ }
```

sam: LGTM. Can you add a micro-benchmark? Measure effective tokens/s across seq buckets [64,128,256,384,768] and report kernel pick ratios. Keep canary at 5% traffic.

elaine: Will run. Quick local numbers after a 2-run test:
```
seq 128: int4 78% picks, tokens/s +12%
seq 384: fp8 picked 63% (was 90% before change), tokens/s -18%
seq 768: fp8 95% (unchanged)
```

perf-bot: Created perf ticket PERF-2026 and alert: "regression: sm90 int4 path suppressed by kvcache multiplier" :rotating_light:

raj: Plan: patch selector to prefer request-level kv_delta and add per-arch knobs. Rollout 5% -> 20% -> 50% canary with 2h windows. Add a short-lived telemetry flag to record (seq_bucket, kernel_chosen, kv_delta_ratio, kvcache_global) for easy analysis.

sam: Can we add a safety gate: if tokens/s drops >10% on canary, auto rollback?

elaine: Yes — will wire the canary policy. I'll post results in this thread when I have the metrics. Thanks folks. :thumbsup:
